dataset.language_slice: Official Rust split at the pinned Hugging Face snapshot; 171 candidate rows reported upstream. Final denominator must be computed after three gold-patch validation runs and an independent task-quality audit.

treatments.changed_factor: CodingAgentConfig.enable_gcs_advisories only; all other agent/model/tool/build/evaluation settings held fixed

environment.os_architecture: Record exact runner OS and architecture before locking
environment.rust_toolchain: Record exact `rustc --version` and Cargo version before locking
environment.network_policy: Strict pass@1 lane: no web/search or task-specific external retrieval; task process may access only the problem_statement and prebuilt sandbox, with dependencies fetched before the run or through an explicitly recorded allowlisted cache. Do not expose hints, patches, test patches, FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS, commit URLs, evaluator logs, or task metadata to the agent. Preserve complete rollout trajectories.
environment.cpu_gpu_description: Record runner hardware and whether GPU is used

endpoints.success_definition: Patch applies; real build/test execution completes; every hidden fail-to-pass and required pass-to-pass test passes; no evaluator error or missing test evidence.

predeclared_rules: Exclude a task only before candidate scoring when base/reference/oracle controls fail reproducibly; preserve reason and evidence.
Do not remove agent failures, timeouts, refusals, missing patches, or unresolved executions silently.
exclusions.unresolved_policy: Report separately and publish arm-adverse sensitivity bounds; unresolved is neither a behavioral fail nor a tie.

artifacts.signature_policy: Preserve raw run artifacts; independently audit from a separate environment; sign or immutably publish the final audit manifest with a separately controlled key where available.
